name: Munakata Shiryuu
source:
A 15 year old with old-fashioned values. The captain of the fencing club, he faces even demons with his beloved sword. The name of his Deva is "Siegfried." He was raised as an orphan in the church.

He's good looking and has a kind personality. Admired by everyone as a good big brother, he serves as the captain of the Spiritus Corps. That's why he's wary of the devil-possessed Maria.

[Translated from [url=http://maria.karin-e.jp/dc/02_chara/03.htm]official website[/url]]
